declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The parties negotiated at arm’s length over the class fund, automatic distribution, and attorneys’ fees and expenses. Fees were discussed alongside class relief from the outset, not only after relief was agreed. The negotiations resulted in a $30 million fund for automatic payments to identifiable class members, plus $4 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval. Brightline did not agree to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any fees not awarded will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. The settlement provides substantial, prompt relief in light of the risks of class certification and trial and the delay associated with continued litigation.
